greetings.text: Ah! Good. I have not a moment to spare. Where is Frodo?
Hamfast's lad? No, I need Frodo. Speak!
Good heavens, yes? What is it? Be quick about it.

farewells.text: I must go. Farewell, and watch the road.
There is no time for more. Shadowfax, away!

smalltalk.text: A wizard is never late. Nor is he early. He arrives precisely when he means to.
Fools and riddles! I shall have no more of them tonight.
Shadowfax goes as the wind. No horse in Middle-earth is his equal.
There is a great deal of darkness in the world. But also a little light.

black_rider_in_hobbiton.text: A Black Rider in the Shire! I feared as much. Where is he now?

black_riders_asking_for_baggins.text: Black Riders at Bree, asking for Baggins. Then I must be quick.

strange_folk_on_east_road.text: Strange folk on the East Road. Yes. Rangers; and others. Troublous times.
